rubric_rows.criterion: Considers the relative-minimum location(s) and the endpoints as candidates
Justification: compares the values of f at all candidates, using net area under f'
Answer
Uses f(8) = f(0) + the integral of f' (signed areas)
Answer

difficulty.label: exam_prep
difficulty.rationale: Typical AP FRQ. Part (a) reads concavity from the slope of f', and (b) applies the first derivative test from sign changes of f'. Part (c) requires a candidates test: compute f at the critical points and endpoints using signed areas under f' (geometric areas, small integers), then compare. Part (d) reuses the (c) computation. The item has multiple representation changes (graph, area, function values) and justification steps, but the arithmetic is light and the wording is unambiguous.
